title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1970-09-19
lineage: [Sony TC-110 with built-in mic > reel > cassette > CD] + [AKG190E > Uher 400L > Technics 1506 playback > Cardas audiophile cables > HHB CDR 800 master CD > CD] > Samsung SW-232B > EAC v0.9b4 > CD Wave > shntool > FLAC16

ai_review.summary: Muffled audience tape obscures much of the music, yet the legendary Dark Star and the sweet Sugar Magnolia/Lovelight segment still shine.
ai_review.review: The recording is plagued by low‑fidelity AUD sources – muffled, bass‑heavy and often impossible to discern performance details – though a brief SBD excerpt of Sugar Magnolia into Lovelight offers a glimpse of clarity. Musically the show is praised for an out‑of‑this‑world Dark Star (ranked among the top ten) and strong mid‑set jams that make it worthwhile for completists despite the technical shortcomings.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviewers consistently praise the Dark Star and key Sweet moments, indicating a strong show (≈4/5), but they all criticize the poor audience‑tape quality (≈2/5). Weighted combination yields ~3.4.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Both AUD tapes are described as muffled, bass‑overloaded and low‑fidelity; one reviewer notes a brief SBD segment of Sugar Magnolia/Lovelight that sounds better. A matrix of the second half of the second set exists but overall audio is hard to follow.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Second‑set’s latter half contains a legendary Dark Star that many rank among the best, with the middle jam described as “groovy.” The overall flow is praised despite the recording obscuring much of the performance.
